reader_summary.headline: Dave is the Founder and Partner of Tidemark Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Dave is the Founder and Partner of Tidemark Capital, which he started in 2021 after 15 years as a General Partner at Technology Crossover Ventures. Dave has been investing in vertical market software as long as anyone I know and he currently sits on the board of two VMS businesses. He is the perfect guest to deliver a primer on VMS, which is exactly what we do in this episode.
